long long pow_mod(long long base, long long exp) {
    long long result = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

                    flag[x] = true;
